time_to_understand.evidence: Brand subtitle states the job ('空间布局工作台 · 落位即意图', index.html:18); sidebar note states the rule in one sentence ('对象中心落在哪个分区，即归属哪个分区——不填表单，摆放即数据', index.html:57); status bar exposes key hints (index.html:69). What/where is conveyed at a glance in both screenshots.

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions are in-place on the canvas (pointer handlers app.js:388-455; keyboard keys.js:11-71); help is a dismissible overlay, not a route (index.html:72-95, Esc close app.js:521-522); feedback via toasts and status bar (app.js:182-190, 163-179); 重置 restores the initial layout in place (app.js:374-382). ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces: topbar (type selector, 新增/吸附/快捷键/重置), canvas + 3 zoom buttons, one ledger panel, status bar (index.html:13-70, 46-50, 54-60, 63-70). Every control maps to a needed operation and a keyboard equivalent (keys.js); no decorative or dead UI visible in either viewport.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, a11y.focus_order=skipped (measurement-summary.json checks). Visible keyboard affordances are strong — complete key equivalents (keys.js:25-69), aria-label on stage and radiogroup (index.html:32, 22), aria-live toasts (index.html:51) — but 11px SVG object labels (styles.css:92), --faint #6b7688 dim tokens on dark background (styles.css:11, 88), and ~20px-tall ledger chips (styles.css:137-142) are consistent with the two a11y failures.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass and both screenshots render cleanly at 1280x860 and 1440x900. But 3 of 7 checks failed (a11y.contrast, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size — measurement-summary.json), each implying a fix pass; plus a wired-feature defect: advertised space-hold pan never activates — spaceDown declared app.js:386, read app.js:392, never set true anywhere (keys.js:74-79 only preventDefaults Space) though help promises '按住空格拖拽平移' (index.html:89).

scores.overall_note: impl-05 is a tightly matched implementation of the cell brief: a single-screen SVG spatial canvas (4 zones, 27 objects) whose placement rule — object center determines zone membership (app.js:67-76) — directly operationalizes the brief's '落位即意图' success criterion, with the ledger's per-zone counts (7/8/6/4/2) matching the canvas exactly in both viewports. The create verb is salient in the topbar, and the acceptance seed (keyboard equivalents for every spatial operation) is implemented in keys.js, documented in a ? overlay, and even backed by an in-page selftest harness. Navigation cost and context loss are minimal: one page, every object reachable in a single interaction, all actions performed in place. The deductions sit on the accessibility/receipt side: a11y.contrast and a11y.target_size fail, type.min_projected_size fails, and a11y.focus_order was skipped, consistent with 11px canvas labels and low-contrast dim tokens; additionally the advertised space-hold pan is never wired in source (app.js:386/392; keys.js:74-79), leaving one documented affordance non-functional. No layout defects are visible in either viewport (layout.overflow, responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass). Model preference is not human preference; task time, retrieval accuracy, and preference are not observable in this blind pilot.
